title: The clauses, verbatim
summary: The page's one paper moment is the document itself: the 9 clauses verbatim in a reading column on the real grid, each under one hairline with its plain number in the margin in the heading's own face at the light weight, clause 01 (the document's summary) at lede size, the rest in the articles' reading style — calm, readable and still.

reference.site: Approved interior header X (round 3 'Specimen sheet', title block retired) and the kit's §12 IX contents strip; the homepage letter/S for the reading grammar (margin label, reading column).
reference.borrowed: Aboard's contract view: a plain document that states its own status before the text ('This contract has not yet been sent'), numbered clauses in one calm column, and its unfilled fields left visible as fields ([Country/State]).
reference.kelwin: The status moves into header X's facts ledger ('Draft, pending legal review'), the clause index becomes the band (the contents strip, no drawing, no red), the clauses sit on the 12-column grid on paper with light display numerals in the margin, and the one unfilled field (Terms 08's jurisdiction) is drawn with the kit's dashed 'not built yet' edge.

motion: entrance: none — a still beat (story map §5: the legal pages carry no body motion). The paper is the cut from the graphite header.

interaction: inline links only (‘the audit’ → /audit in clause 02, the one link the map adds); each clause is an anchor target for the contents strip (scroll-margin-top 112px clears production's condensed nav).
on the live site: static. Reduced motion: identical.
notes: Reading surface: the section is ≈2,715px at 1440 and deliberately exceeds the 1400px cap — it is not cropped because the founder is reviewing the clauses verbatim. Grid: number cols 1–2, heading and text cols 3–8 — the articles' column and the articles' reading style (18px/1.6, full ink, text-wrap: pretty, hanging punctuation), so the two templates share one ReadingSpread; it sets a median 73–76 characters a line (64–83), wider than the map's 'about 66ch' exactly as the articles do (narrowing is a shared call, see kitNeeds), hairlines cols 1–8, cols 9–12 left empty as the outer margin of a printed page (no sidenotes: legal text carries no glosses). Clause headings are h2 (the h1 is in the header); each carries a visually hidden ‘0n’ so a screen reader hears the number the eye sees in the margin. Inline links use a quiet underline defined here (the kit's three actions are caps components, unusable inside a sentence) — see kitNeeds. Clause 08's ‘[JURISDICTION — EDIT ME]’ is kept verbatim and drawn as an unfilled field (dashed edge, mono) — a go-live blocker, never shipped. Inline links never break across a line (white-space: nowrap), so their underline stays one stroke.
story: Beat 2 of 3. The text, and nothing else: no drawing, no pull quote, no sidenote. Clause 01 is the scope of the terms, so it reads first and largest; the rest follow as a plain numbered document, with the one unfilled field left visibly unfilled.
